findings.summary: Billboard passes follow the scene's published renderables (deferred publication drained at registration, renderable version trigger) on both backends, with one build path per backend and no first-frame completion flag.

Resolve billboard alpha-to-coverage through alpha_to_coverage_enabled in the shared draw plan, and refuse a change only where the pin would observe it (cutout, multisampled, drawn by a registered scene).
Share the billboard instance-buffer growth check between backends (ensure_billboard_instance_capacity).
Snapshot a small billboard pass source instead of whole records, and share immutable atlas texels with preparation jobs instead of copying them.
One add_deferred_scene_renderables helper for text, billboards and depth-hosted sprite layers, refusing attachment after disposal; text and sprite layers follow the renderable version too.
Split Dawn's material dispatch into ensure_draw_state and write_draw_blocks so setup shares the frame's ensure half; setup makes per-draw buffers only, groups build in the frame.
Run native preparation unguarded in every build and stop re-testing Dawn device synchronization per draw.
One owner for a render target's requested sample count (render_target_requested_samples) used by both backends' scene and frame-graph code.
Return background arm buffers as (kind, buffers) pairs instead of index-coupled walks.
One shared setup coroutine (prepare_scene_pipelines) builds backgrounds beside pipeline compilation for both backends.
Prepare every row's new textures in one native job and wait once, instead of one frame wait per mesh (upload_scene_meshes).
Skip motion-state synchronization on all but the last physics sub-step.
findings.blockedBy: Declined after measurement: skipping needed a catch-up that restores Bullet's interpolation transforms around its own sync for bodies that sleep mid-step, for about 0.05 ms per step; the parallel per-sub-step sync is kept.

findings.summary: Per-thread sparse landing lists merged in manifold order replace the dense per-manifold scratch.
Keep physics world membership in one owner_world pointer written only by admit and leave (shared by evict and close).
Check the thread's last recovery entry first and pad per-thread slots to cache lines.
Split hull sourcing from derivation, use range assignment, and key the hull table by bytes with sweep-on-doubling.
for_each_index takes begin, end and grain and replaces the hand-written SetupWork loop.
Guard the Bullet internals the physics PAL mirrors with a static_assert on BT_BULLET_VERSION naming each copied function.
Read typed value facts instead of matching emitted (*name) text in movesReturnedLocal and namesStableOwner; record ownership on nativeBindingTypes; spell optional reads through optionalValueCpp.
Give the audio main-bus graph one statement builder used by both the direct and the realm paths.
Store an environment struct's concreteness instead of deriving borrowed-member references from an unstated invariant.
Emit the source-profile scope and the recent-results memo through one function-body prologue, and fail generation on --source-profile names that time nothing.
One function naming rule (sourceFunctionName) for profiling, the survey and refusal messages, including method and callback refusals.
Apply the RecentStrings memo to every pure number-to-string function shape, not only top-level declarations.
Collapse native jobs to one layer on a bounded worker pool with idle exit, a cap that leaves the physics workers' share, and a refusal for native work that waits on native work.
Record the start-order settlement rule and why per-kind queues would change observable settlement order.
One SDL audio rule: the main thread initializes audio once for the run, overlapping the application thread's start; devices open on any thread and never quit it.
Make the playback device an alias of the SDL device, give the capture check one owner, and share one display wait in the window realm.
Define the native cache directory independently of ccache so content-addressed headers never land at the drive root.

Decode loadTexture2D images once at load with the upload transforms, share them with atlases and the first upload, and drop untaken texels at the next frame boundary; one orientation owner and one read-and-decode helper.
Keep pal_image.hpp codec-only by moving texture-record texel helpers to pal_texture_texels.hpp.
Remove the process-wide image decoder mutex so native workers decode in parallel.
findings.blockedBy: SDL_image updates unsynchronized codec counters on every load; making them atomic needs an sdl3-image overlay-port patch, which re-keys the vcpkg installation and rebuilds every scene.

findings.summary: Replace the Map/Set lookup caches with an open-addressing index, a lazily built dense index for small integer keys, and SameValueZero keys; clear keeps capacity.
One seeded byte hash (byte_hash.hpp) for string keys and shared geometry identity; entry keys are returned by pointer.

Split realm glTF loading into a native read/parse/prepare job and a realm apply, with one decode owner per planned primitive, tables built once, ORM composites and the BRDF table prepared off the realm, and stored errors rethrown in document order.
Share the backgrounds-beside-pipelines setup block, the billboard membership match, and the physics member reset instead of copying them per site.
State backend facts once in docs/backends.md and leave worker and texel mechanics to the code that owns them.
